visual_logic.surface_detail: Tactile, leathery skin texture with 'Silver-Grey' and 'Coral White' highlights, running uniformly across its extended horizontal profile.
visual_logic.environment: Fine white carbonate sand floor with refractive 'caustic' light patterns dancing on the reptile's back. Sand and lighting textures are layered into the background to preserve a sharp, measurable silhouette line.
visual_logic.facial_expression: A signature friendly smirk and large, dark aquatic eyes oriented perfectly to face laterally in the frame.

pose: The small marine lizard is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original relaxed gliding pose is stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its smirking head, elongated torso, limbs (flattened toward the camera plane), and long tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
